t_advice_summary_textbox.text: They said that the gnomes come in matched sets for example purple vs blue red vs yellow. choose the smaller hat in each set then go for a colour then pick between the pair of them that provide the more mushrooms all though it could change and to go with my brain instinct because it works quicker than the concious mind

vb_textbox.text: Start off by picking the smaller hat wearer as you get to grips with the game then try to do the right hand side on 5 x and pick yellow small hats the most
